original_prompt: Perform a 2D supersonic flow simulation over a wedge. Create a 3D geometry spanning from -0.15242 m to 0.3048 m in the x-direction, 0 m to 0.1524 m in the y-direction, and -0.005 m to 0.005 m in the z-direction. The simulation starts at 0.0 seconds and runs until 0.2 seconds with a time step (deltaT) of 0.0001 seconds. The results are written every 0.02 seconds. The inlet velocity is 10 m/s, inlet temperature is 2 K and inlet pressure is 1 Pa. The wedge boundary uses slip boundary condition for velocity. Use normalized thermodynamic properties where molWeight is set to 11640.3, Cp is 2.5, Pr is 1.0, and dynamic viscosity mu is 0. This corresponds to a gas constant R of 0.7143 and a specific heat ratio of 1.4. Use rhoCentralFoam solver. Do not use more than 4800 cells in your mesh.
adaptation: 补齐15度楔面实际端点，源入口温度/速度变化但内部初值始终1K及5m/s，按配置保留；mu=0下Pr变体数学等价；用R=5/7替代近似0.7143且保留molWeight标签。
numerical_controls: 原deltaT/Co/软件与算法不约束考生；保留物理输出时刻。
